title: Marketplace Orders Unreturned-Replacement Charge
content:
## Terms

On Marketplace Orders, the unreturned-replacement deadline is the replacement date, the date recorded on the replacement entry, which is the day the replacement ships, plus the option's unreturned replacement days counted in calendar days; a first carrier scan of the original unit on the deadline itself is in time.

Except for a lost package, when the original unit has no first carrier scan by the unreturned-replacement deadline, the replacement charge falls due and the buyer settles it as a payment on the order, captured as an unreturned-replacement charge tied to the return the replacement was shipped against.

### When the charge falls due

| Replacement shipped for | First carrier scan of the original unit | Replacement charge |
|---|---|---|
| a lost package | — | does not fall due |
| any other basis | on or before the deadline | does not fall due |
| any other basis | none by the deadline | falls due; settled by the buyer as a payment on the order |

### Hypothetical deadline case

A hypothetical replacement recorded on 4 May on an option with 30 unreturned replacement days has its deadline on 3 June. A first scan of the original on 3 June is in time; with no first scan by the end of 3 June the charge falls due. The dates are example inputs.

## Payment tool: `pay_replacement_charge_b3f7fc80`

**Capability.** The buyer pays, from the card on file, the charge owed on one of their own marketplace orders for a replacement whose original unit was not sent back in time. One call records one payment capture dated today on that order, marked as an unreturned-replacement charge and tied to the return the replacement was shipped against, and raises the order's net amount paid by the amount paid. The buyer sees the payment on the order immediately.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_replacement_charge_b3f7fc80` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to pay.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the marketplace order number the replacement was shipped for, as given to the buyer by the support agent from the order lookup | identifier |
| `return_id` | the return number of the original unit the replacement was shipped against, as given to the buyer by the support agent from the order activity lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount paid in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; captured exactly as given |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` the literal "paid" when the payment was captured; `order_event_id` the reference of the payment entry; `order_id` the order paid on; `return_id` the return the payment relates to; `amount` the USD amount captured with 2 decimal places; `net_paid_amount` the order's net amount paid including this payment, USD with 2 decimal places; `event_date` the payment date as YYYY-MM-DD.
